resources.string: Coordinate numbers in Sky and Globe panoramas stay visible when zooming in.
Latitude labels sit closer to free edges, also in landscape with information panels.
Grid numbers stay aligned with their lines and avoid buttons and panels.
Close and Later now use normal text colours for the day and night themes.
Confirmations stay blue or cyan; discarding changes and removing items stay red.
Cancel in a removal confirmation is neutral, making each action easier to distinguish.
